title: A live wild Runner completes one normal stop skid

verification.actor: WILD species 234 (Stantler), acquired through spawn; live handle and attached presentation required
verification.trigger: Leave the same live Runner Stantler near the player on neutral input through its normal alert run until the Tired lifecycle requests a stop
verification.observable: A normal NONE Walk-policy request starts one accepted one-tile eight-frame stop skid from speed four, commits once, and returns idle with no Movement Chain movement, action, or pause action

setupMutations.change: Disposable test.sav, native Stantler spawn at map33 (584,406), and exact identity bind. Do not change the behavior profile, controller state, timer, input, timing, chain action, chain pause, path, or actor state during observation.

limits: Prepared spawning does not prove natural population spawning.
This proves the Runner Tired stop on the fixed Route 29 save position. It does not prove every possible terrain target.
Registration alone is not runtime acceptance; the checked shared test must pass on the current ROM.

invariants: The Tired stop input has direction NONE, distance one, travel time eight, and stop-skid flags
